title: The Broken Road trilogy
description: Read The Broken Road in order: The Wall that Lied, No Wall to Hold and What We Save.
intro: The Broken Road follows engineer Tomas Parker through three novels. Start with The Wall that Lied in the city of Auster, follow the roads beyond it in No Wall to Hold, then finish with What We Save. The first Kindle edition is available now on Amazon Australia.

title: Jason Proud and the ToKnight books
description: Start Jason Proud's middle-grade fantasy story with ToKnight, then continue with ToKnight 2: The Fire Beneath.
intro: Start Jason Proud’s middle-grade fantasy story with ToKnight, then follow him into ToKnight 2: The Fire Beneath. Read them in that order to follow the adventure from the beginning.

title: Free to a Good Home and A Place of His Own
description: Read Free to a Good Home, then the later story A Place of His Own.
intro: Begin with Free to a Good Home, then return to Tom, Max and Jonah in its sequel, A Place of His Own. These connected novels follow them at different points in their lives.
